description: The binding takes a grant now. The grant must carry this grant_generation, last at most max_lifetime_s, and be issued at this machine's now (within 60 s). The binding is the fixture's sample binding, and the values are those of a harness that takes grants (Codex in this release: max_text_bytes 131072). A pi binding answers mode_unreadable, as in frame 43, unless its live bridge gates tool calls (bridge revision 6, gate, surface tui). The wire is the same for every harness; which harness reports a mode that asks is the machine's decision.
